## Mo ta

## Loai thay doi

- [ ] Tinh nang moi (feat)
- [ ] Sua loi (fix)

- [ ] Tai lieu (docs)

- [ ] CI/CD
- [ ] Khac

## Checklist

- [ ] Code tuan thu kien truc Clean Architecture
- [ ] `flutter analyze` khong co loi
- [ ] `flutter test` pass
- [ ] Da viet test cho logic moi (neu co)
- [ ] Da cap nhat CHANGELOG.md (neu can)
